covered: the repository demo pins official sentry-native 0.17.4, Crashpad, curl transport and a SHA-1 ELF build-id on Linux/amd64
main.c compiles the named non-inlined goodsentry_demo_crash function with DWARF
the exact crashing executable is uploaded through the authenticated files/dsyms/ route
one intentional Crashpad fault using the same binary and project DSN is captured
the stored native event resolves goodsentry_demo_crash to main.c with a positive line by the ELF Debug ID
no Minidump bytes are retained in attachments or envelope items
the same acceptance passes with the race detector
limits: The run is local against disposable PostgreSQL; public CI and the final image remain for the final audit.
This proves one local Sentry SDK workflow, not the broader native architecture/format matrix.
The product is not declared an acceptance candidate or closed.
